name: Richard Gray
role: Agent of the N. P. Refrigerator Car Co.
bio: Richard Gray represented the company's interests at Fargo and visited Medora in February 1884. In November 1884 an R. Gray, agent for the N. P. R. C. Co. at Helena, spent a Sunday in Medora.
mentions: Lawyer Carpenter, of Dickinson, has been in town for several days on legal business.
Mr. Richard Gray, who represents the Co's. interests at Fargo is in town on business.
Mr. R. Gray, agent for the N. P. R. C. Co. at Helena, spent Sunday in Medora.
